elements.description:
Select text and translate it in place: the translation in a card with the detected language, Copy, Replace in place
and Show original. The app translates; the element never calls a service.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The text: plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines. Offsets index into it

properties.name: editable
properties.description: Replace in place is offered: the text can be changed by the element (tc-text-change)

properties.name: target
properties.description: The language to translate into, as a code from `languages`. Changed from the card unless a tc-target-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: languages
properties.default: [ { code: "en", name: "English" }, { code: "es", name: "Spanish" }, { code: "fr", name: "French" }, { code: "de", name: "German" }, { code: "it", name: "Italian" }, { code: "pt", name: "Portuguese" }, { code: "nl", name: "Dutch" }, { code: "pl", name: "Polish" }, { code: "ja", name: "Japanese" }, { code: "ko", name: "Korean" }, { code: "zh", name: "Chinese" }, { code: "ar", name: "Arabic" }, { code: "hi", name: "Hindi" }, ]

properties.name: resolveTranslate
properties.description: Translates when no tc-translate listener answers: (text, target, signal) => { text, source? }

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-translate
events.description: A translation is needed ({ text, target, start, end, signal, respondWith }: SelectionTranslateRequest); answer with `detail.respondWith()`, or leave it to `resolveTranslate`; prevented without an answer, the card closes

events.name: tc-target-change
events.description: The target language was changed in the card ({ target }: SelectionTranslateTargetChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `target`

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: Copy was chosen on a translation ({ text }: SelectionTranslateCopy); cancelable – prevent it to copy your own way

events.name: tc-text-change
events.description: Replace was chosen ({ text, previous, start, end, replacement, target }: SelectionTranslateTextChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `text`

methods.name: langName
methods.description: A language's name: from `languages`, else the browser's name for the code, else as given

props.name: text
props.description: The text, plain. Controlled when defined (with `onTextChange`); otherwise the component keeps it, starting at `defaultText`

props.name: onTextChange
props.description: Called with the new text when Replace puts a translation in place (needs `editable`)

props.name: target
props.description: The target language's code. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps it, starting at `defaultTarget`

props.name: onTargetChange
props.description: Called when the target language is changed in the card – store it to remember the choice

props.name: onTranslate
props.description: Called for every translation the card needs; answer with `request.respondWith()`, or leave it to `resolveTranslate`. Return false to take it elsewhere (the card closes)

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called when Copy is chosen on a translation; return false to stop the component writing to the clipboard itself

changelog: **Text selection:** - `tc-text-annotator`: highlight a passage and comment on it; - `tc-response-selection`: select part of a model reply to reply to it or request an edit; - `tc-selection-translate`: translate the selected text; - `tc-isbn-details`: hover an ISBN for its book details.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
